prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic transparent foreground product cutout for a sophisticated dark Caffè TTC website.
Primary request: a real warm ivory ceramic cappuccino cup containing caramel crema and a crisp white latte-art rosetta, sitting on its matching sculptural ceramic saucer.
Style/medium: extremely detailed high-end editorial product photography, tactile real matte ceramic, natural coffee foam.
Composition/framing: square image, entire cup and saucer visible, centered with generous transparent margins. Three-quarter overhead camera angle, handle points right. Beautiful dimensional angle showing the opening and outside of the cup and saucer.
Lighting/mood: soft natural warm directional light from upper left, elegant soft photographic shading, bright readable edges for compositing against a nearly black webpage.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent alpha background, no surface or surroundings. Subject fully isolated.
Constraints: realistic warm product colors, no holographic appearance, no blue tint, no neon, no glow, no graphics, no text, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects, no cropped edges. Do not render a fake checkerboard. Generate genuine alpha transparency.
